# stalwart_spam_tag_score (Resource)

Defines a score or action assigned to a spam classification tag. Manages the Assign Score variant.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (String) The spam tag name

### Optional

- `score` (Number) The score for the tag

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier.
